summary: Player-vehicle selector (stdcall, arg a1 = vehicle index): stores the computed player vehicle pointer (vehicle array base unk_5EC6D8 + stride 18624 * a1) into dword_7C54E0, then scans dword_7C54F0 (vehicle pointer array) for an entry equal to that pointer. On match it records the matching array index in dword_7C54DC and returns it; if the array is exhausted (104 entries) without a match, it returns 104. Vehicle-subsystem helper used by dispatch and network/session paths.

operations.description: Compute the player vehicle pointer = (int)&unk_5EC6D8 + 18624 * a1 (stride 18624 = vehicle array element size) and write it to dword_7C54E0 as the current player vehicle pointer.
Initialize the array search index result = 0.
Linear search over dword_7C54F0 (vehicle pointer array) from index 0, comparing each entry against the computed player vehicle pointer.
Loop continues while dword_7C54F0[result] != computed player vehicle pointer; on equality the loop exits to the match handling.
Exhaustion guard: if ++result >= 104 (array limit), return result (not-found path) immediately without recording an index.
On a match, store the found array index into dword_7C54DC (current player vehicle array index).
Return the matching array index, or 104 when no array entry equals the computed player vehicle pointer.
